blocks.en: We now prove a result which is sometimes called the \emph{analytic Fredholm theorem}. This is the basis for two important results: the Fredholm alternative theorem (Theorem~\ref{thm:fredholm-alternative-compact}) and the Hilbert-Schmidt theorem (Theorem~\ref{thm:hilbert-schmidt-spectral}).
blocks.zh: 现在证明一个有时称为\emph{解析 Fredholm 定理}的结果. 它是两个重要结果的基础: Fredholm 二择一定理 (Theorem~\ref{thm:fredholm-alternative-compact}) 和 Hilbert-Schmidt 定理 (Theorem~\ref{thm:hilbert-schmidt-spectral}).

blocks.en: We now use the analytic Fredholm theorem to derive the following characterization of the spectrum of a compact operator on a Hilbert space.
blocks.zh: 现在利用解析 Fredholm 定理, 导出以下关于 Hilbert 空间上紧算子的谱的刻画.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $A\in\mathcal{L}(H)$ be compact. Then $\sigma(A)$ is a compact set having no limit point except perhaps $\lambda=0$. Furthermore, given any $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}\backslash\{0\}$, either\begin{enumerate}\item $\lambda\in\rho(A)$, or\item $\lambda\in\sigma_p(A)$ is an eigenvalue of finite multiplicity.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 设 $A\in\mathcal{L}(H)$ 为紧算子. 那么 $\sigma(A)$ 为紧集, 除可能的 $\lambda=0$ 外没有极限点. 此外, 给定任意 $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}\backslash\{0\}$, 以下两者之一成立:\begin{enumerate}\item $\lambda\in\rho(A)$, 或者\item $\lambda\in\sigma_p(A)$ 为有限重数的特征值.\end{enumerate}
